blocks.text: Organic chemistry functional groups ke gird tarteeb di jati hai. Halanke karoron organic compounds maloom hain, functional groups gine chune hain, aur har aik compounds ke aik khandan ki pehchan hai. Functional group organic compound ka woh hissa hai jahan us ke zyada tar reactions hote hain.

Organic synthesis mein chemists saada, aasani se milne wale ajza se target molecule banane ke mumkin raaste tay karte hain. Functional groups markazi kirdar ada karte hain: in se chemists un reactions ka andaza aur qabu kar pate hain jo matloob product tak le jate hain. Compound ke functional groups pehchanna us ki khasiyaton ka andaza lagane mein bhi madad deta hai, jo naye products banane aur dawaiyon aur khurak ke izafi maaddon jaise products ki safai aur banawat yaqeeni banane ke liye ahem hai.

blocks.prompt: Organic synthesis ki mansooba bandi mein functional groups markazi kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar reactions functional group par hote hain, is liye groups jaan kar chemist andaza aur qabu kar sakta hai ke kaun se reactions target molecule denge.

items: Functional group woh jagah jahan compound ke zyada tar reactions hote.
Synthesis saada, dastiyab compounds se target banati hai.
